All countries need to produce food.
Which type of agriculture would make the best use of the resources of developing and developed
economies?
developing developed

A farmer reduces the land used to grow wheat from 80 hectares to 60 hectares and increases the
use of the land for growing potatoes from 80 to 100 hectares.
What is the opportunity cost of this change?

options.text: The output from 20 hectares used for growing potatoes.
The output from 20 hectares used for growing wheat.
The output from 60 hectares used for growing wheat.
The output from 80 hectares used for growing potatoes.

the price at which the producer breaks even
the price at which the supply and demand curves intersect

A government lowers interest rates to encourage more borrowing and spending by households to
increase economic growth.
Why could this lead to a conflict with other government aims?

options.text: It could cause uncertainty and lead to lower demand.
It could encourage more savings and lead to higher unemployment.

It has the world’s greatest size of population.
It has the world’s highest standard of living.
